mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocr_binding ( archive_version_id, task_id, document_type, status, engine_version, processing_duration_ms, review_required, error_code, error_message, preview_url, preview_content_type, preview_size, preview_sha256, preview_width, preview_height, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{versionId}, #{taskId}, #{documentType}, #{status}, #{engineVersion}, #{processingDurationMs}, #{reviewRequired}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{previewUrl}, #{previewContentType}, #{previewSize}, #{previewSha256}, #{previewWidth}, #{previewHeight}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ocr_binding SET task_id = #{taskId}, document_type = #{documentType}, status = #{status}, engine_version = #{engineVersion}, processing_duration_ms = #{processingDurationMs}, review_required = #{reviewRequired}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, preview_url = #{previewUrl}, preview_content_type = #{previewContentType}, preview_size = #{previewSize}, preview_sha256 = #{previewSha256}, preview_width = #{previewWidth}, preview_height = #{previewHeight}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ocr_binding SET confirm_status = #{confirmStatus}, confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt}, confirm_note = #{confirmNote}, updated_at = #{confirmedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocr_field_revision (binding_id, field_code, previous_value, current_value, reason, operator_id, created_at) VALUES (#{bindingId}, #{fieldCode}, #{previousValue}, #{currentValue}, #{reason}, #{operatorId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, binding_id, field_code, previous_value, current_value, reason, operator_id, created_at FROM ocr_field_revision WHERE binding_id = #{bindingId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
